item.title: Jon Hanshaw named Information Security Officer at Community First Banking Company
item.description: Mark Sloan, President & CEO of Community First Banking Company has announced that Jon Hanshaw has been named Information Security Officer. Hanshaw has over 9 years of bank experience and has been with Community First since 2022.

item.title: Traffic fatalities decline in 2025 in Missouri
item.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo. – Missouri leaders on Tuesday announced data showing that traffic fatalities declined in 2025 for the third year in a row, marking a significant milestone in the state’s ongoing effort to improve roadway safety.
